turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Hey David, Emily found an issue on the checkout page.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay. What's the issue?

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: The discount code gets removed when the customer changes the shipping method.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay. Does it happen every time?

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: Yeah, I can reproduce it consistently on staging.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Got it. What are the steps to reproduce it?

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: First, add a product to the cart and apply a valid discount code.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: Then go to checkout and change the shipping method. The discount disappears after that.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Right. What should happen instead?

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: The discount should stay applied unless it's no longer valid.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Got it. Does this happen with all discount codes?

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: So far, I've only tested percentage-based codes.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Okay. I'll take a look at the checkout logic and see what's happening.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Is this blocking checkout?

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: No, customers can still place the order, but they lose the discount.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Okay. So it's not blocking, but it can affect the order total.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Yeah. I'll investigate the discount validation first.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: When do you think you can have a fix?

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: I should know more after I check the code. I'll give you an update this afternoon.

turns.speaker: Sarah
turns.text: Sounds good. Once it's fixed, Emily, can you retest it?

turns.speaker: Emily
turns.text: Sure. I'll run the same steps and check a few different discount codes.

turns.speaker: David
turns.text: Perfect.
